title: kohautia brachyloba
intro: Kohautia brachyloba, commonly known as Red Sage, is a plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to alleviate various health conditions such as fever, headache, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Red Sage include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, making it a popular remedy for various health ailments. Bioactive constituents of Kohautia brachyloba include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
